author: the_pretender
quote: This is the greatest game of all time. It makes you feel the beauty of a well written story and reminds us of all the steps of innovation in the history of videogames. As the first 3d mainline Zelda, it innovated everything from Z-targeting to early methods of controlling a 3d character to extensive item menus, to dungeon level design. It did so much for videogames as a medium it will be remembered years and years into the future. It deserves its place in history as the greatest game ever made for this very reason.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: the_pretender
quote: This is the best remake to the best game of all time. It is by all means a Zelda game to be loved for all time. Can't wait for Majora's Mask remake! What a great game!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: the_pretender
quote: Graphics can't compensate for numerous bugs. I don't think it deserves to be called the greatest game of all time by that metric. Far from Game of the Year.
